trades.reasoning: Full four-signal confirmation (bullish RSI zone, MACD crossover, rising histogram, price above SMA-20, volume surge) on a risk-on day.
Bullish RSI zone with MACD crossover and price above SMA-20 gives solid but not full confirmation.
RSI in bullish zone with MACD crossover and price above SMA-20 supports a medium-conviction add while diversifying away from tech.

decisions.briefing: NASDAQ +1.4% and S&P 500 +0.6% mark a risk-on day, and with 3 open slots and cash above the $500 threshold we deployed into our top-scoring candidates. AMZN gets high conviction on a full 4-signal confirmation, while ASST and RIG add medium-conviction diversification.

market_education.summary_en: Markets traded broadly higher today with the NASDAQ outpacing the S&P 500, suggesting renewed appetite for growth and tech names. No specific news catalysts were available in today's feed, so the move appears driven by continued momentum in large-cap tech and semiconductor-adjacent names. Breadth of bullish technical signals (MACD crossovers, rising volume) across the screened list reinforces a risk-on tone.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市普遍向好，納指升幅跑贏標普500指數，反映市場對增長股及科技股的risk appetite有所回升。今日資訊中未見具體新聞觸發事件，估計升勢主要由大型科技股及半導體相關股份的持續動能帶動。篩選名單中多隻股份同時出現MACD黃金交叉及成交量放大等利好技術信號，進一步確認risk-on格局。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Instead of relying on a single indicator, traders look for several bullish signals lining up together — like RSI in a healthy range, a MACD crossover, price above its moving average, and a volume surge. When all of these agree, it's a stronger signal of real buying interest rather than random noise.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 交易者不會只靠單一指標做決定，而是尋找多個利好訊號同時出現——例如RSI處於健康區間、MACD出現黃金交叉、股價高於均線，加上成交量放大。當這些訊號同時成立時，代表買盤動力較為真實，而非單純的隨機波動。
